supply_depot.title: Supply Depot
supply_depot.subtitle: Browse and install curated apps, or add your own custom apps by providing a Docker image.
supply_depot.no_internet: No internet connection. You may not be able to download files.
supply_depot.modal_stop_desc: The container will be stopped. Your data is preserved.
supply_depot.modal_restart_desc: The container will be briefly stopped and restarted.
supply_depot.modal_reinstall_warning: This will delete all app data and cannot be undone.
supply_depot.modal_reinstall_desc: The container and its associated volumes will be removed, then a fresh installation will begin.
supply_depot.modal_delete_warning: This will permanently remove this custom app.
supply_depot.modal_delete_desc: The container will be stopped and removed. Host volume data will remain on disk.
supply_depot.modal_uninstall_warning: This will remove the app from this device.
supply_depot.modal_uninstall_desc: The container will be stopped and removed, and the app returns to the catalog below. App data under the storage folder stays on disk, so reinstalling brings it back as it was.
supply_depot.remove_image: Also remove the Docker image to reclaim disk space
supply_depot.port_bound_by: Currently bound by: {{usedBy}}. Installation may fail.
